subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw support a public per-profile cooldown-reset command that requires a safe Gateway restart as the recovery contract for limits that reset early?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but choosing manual CLI recovery versus automatic provider probing, shorter backoff, doctor repair, or an in-product recovery surface is a product and operator-experience decision that code correctness alone cannot settle.

options.title: Accept manual reset
options.body: Land the profile-scoped command after inspectable runtime proof and green required checks, keeping automatic probing and fallback policy unchanged.

options.title: Move to doctor recovery
options.body: Expose the same persisted-state repair through a diagnostic/fix flow so operators receive detection and guided recovery rather than a standalone command.

options.title: Require automatic recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and design provider-health or bounded re-probe behavior that clears stale state without terminal intervention.

recommendation.title: Accept manual reset
recommendation.body: Land the profile-scoped command after inspectable runtime proof and green required checks, keeping automatic probing and fallback policy unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of auth cooldown lifecycle and invariants, making this the best available routing candidate for the recovery-contract decision.
